name: Mall Shop Door Header · 2 m
summary: A limestone fascia and stepped rear infill over the existing glazed mall door.
description: A 400 mm high header for the 2 m wall opening. Its 2.10 m wide face rests on the original door frame. Honed limestone panels and slim bronze returns complete the opening.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original stepped Blender geometry and independently editable cladding. Reuses the original project wall limestone artwork.

assembly.root: door head at wall centreline, glTF +Z outward

rights: Original owner-project geometry, materials and artwork. Public download and redistribution terms are unspecified.

attribution.credit: Original Blender-3D-Gallery geometry and renders. Honed limestone artwork from mall-wall-module-2m.

accuracy_notes: Static visual header for this 2 m opening and original double door. The door is operated by its own assembly. Installation, structural and fire performance require separate assessment.
